title: SteeringSafety: Benchmarking Representation Steering in LLMs Across Safety Perspectives
abstract: arXiv:2509.13450v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce SteeringSafety, a benchmark for evaluating representation steering methods across nine safety perspectives spanning 18 datasets. While prior work highlights the general capabilities of representation steering, we focus on safety perspectives including refusal, bias, hallucination, social behaviors, reasoning, epistemic integrity, and normative judgment. SteeringSafety provides modularized building blocks for state-of-the-art steering methods, enabling unified implementation of DIM, ACE, CAA, PCA, and LAT with recent enhancements such as conditional steering. Results on Gemma-2-2B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen-2.5-7B show that strong steering performance depends on the pairing of method, model, and specific perspective. For instance, DIM is consistently effective, yet all methods exhibit substantial entanglement, where improving effectiveness on one safety perspective often significantly changes performance on others. translated_title: 转向安全：跨安全视角的LLMs表示转向基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.13450v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们引入了SteeringSafety，这是一个用于评估表示转向方法的基准测试，涵盖9个安全视角、18个数据集。尽管先前的工作强调了表示转向的一般能力，但我们专注于安全视角，包括拒绝、偏见、幻觉、社会行为、推理、认知完整性和规范性判断。SteeringSafety为最先进的转向方法提供了模块化构建块，支持DIM、ACE、CAA、PCA和LAT的统一实现，并包含条件转向等最新增强功能。在Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen-2.5-7B上的结果表明，强大的转向性能取决于方法、模型和特定视角的配对。例如，DIM始终有效，但所有方法都表现出显著的纠缠性，即在一个安全视角上提高有效性往往会导致其他视角性能发生显著变化。
tldr: 该论文提出了SteeringSafety基准，系统评估了多种表示转向方法在九个安全视角上的表现，发现转向性能依赖于方法-模型-视角的匹配，且所有方法均存在视角间的纠缠效应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SteeringSafety, a benchmark evaluating representation steering methods across nine safety perspectives, revealing that steering performance depends on method-model-perspective pairing and that all methods exhibit substantial cross-perspective entanglement.
